gloss: to have no prospect; have nothing to go on

definitions.gloss: to have no prospect; have nothing to go on; have no clue
definitions.explanation: Indicates a lack of any reliable lead, plan, or person to depend on for achieving something. {当|あ}て means a dependable hope or expectation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当|あ}てがない。
⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧{当|あ}てがないまま⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I set off on the trip with no place to stay lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧{当|あ}てがなくて⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm in trouble because I have no one to borrow money from.

notes:
{当|あ}て means a dependable hope or expectation — a person, plan, or resource one can rely on. The negative ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ states that no such thing exists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当|あ}てがない: to have no job prospects
- {当|あ}て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk with no destination in mind
- {当|あ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はずれる: one's expectations are disappointed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no prospects — emphasizes the likelihood of success
- ⟦{当|あ}てにする→当てにする：25856_atenisuru⟧: to count on — the positive expression, 'to rely on something'
